newsitem.title: UK: Vote of no confidence in UK govt on March 10.
newsitem.headline: Vote of no confidence in UK govt on March 10.

text.p: The government of British Prime Minister John Major will face a vote of no confidence on March 10, Scottish nationalists said on Thursday.
Scottish National Party spokeswoman Margaret Ewing said it had tabled the motion and she invited other opposition parties to join her to bring down the Conservative government.

Major faces defeat in a by-election in a few hours which will put his government in a minority in parliament. But the Ulster Unionists, whose support is essential for any vote of confidence to succeed, said earlier on Thursday they would not provoke an early election. The election must be held by May 22.
